name: Process, gas-transmission and power piping codes and pipe classes
description: Defines materials, design, fabrication, assembly, erection, examination, inspection and testing for piping. B31.3 governs plant process piping, B31.8 gas transmission/distribution including offshore gathering appurtenances, and B31.1 power/boiler-external piping.
